# TWDB water-use reports

Original public-viewer PDF and CSV exports for Study Butte/Terlingua Water System, PWS TX0220035, survey0827151. Retrieved October23,2026 from the [official TWDB report viewer](https://www3.twdb.texas.gov/apps/reports/WU/Historical_FinalWaterUseSurvey?year=2025&surveyno=0827151&rs:Command=Render) (change year to2024 for the earlier report). Retrieved through the viewer with a fresh anonymous session.

Attribution: Texas Water Development Board. Redistribution follows [TWDB's copyright policy](https://www.twdb.texas.gov/policies/site/index.asp). These government records are not relicensed under this project's MIT license.

Raw intake, retail consumption and rated treatment capacity are different quantities. Raw intake minus retail consumption is not a leakage estimate. PDF tables preserve information not present in every CSV row. Reported source/aquifer labels are retained and need comparison with actual well logs before geological inference.
